item.title: Celtics could be Cavaliers’ kryptonite in playoff matchup | Jeff Schudel
item.description: If there was any doubt before the nationally televised game at Rocket Arena on March 8, there is none now. The Cavaliers would like to avoid facing the Boston Celtics in the playoffs as long as possible. The Celtics, taking advantage of Cleveland making just four of 25 shots from the field in the second quarter and two of 22 3s in the first half, trounced the Cavaliers, 109-98, to complete a 3-0 sweep of the season series. item.title: Celtics beat Cavaliers, 109-98, to sweep season series
item.description: Jaylen Brown scored 23 points and Jayson Tatum had 20 in his second game back from a torn right Achilles, lifting the Boston Celtics to a 109-98 win over the Cavaliers in a battle of Eastern Conference contenders on the afternoon of March 8. Brown also had nine rebounds and eight assists as the Celtics built an 81-55 lead in the third quarter, sweeping their three-game season series with Cleveland. item.title: Guardians option Aleman, Espino to Columbus, tie Rockies in Cactus League game, 4-4
item.description: The Guardians optioned right-handed pitchers Franco Aleman and Daniel Espino to Triple-A Columbus on March 8 before their Cactus League game against the Rockies. They also reassigned outfielder Alfonsin Rosario and left-hander Ryan Webb to minor-league camp. Cleveland (8-8-1) and host Colorado played to a 4-4 draw.
